oai_dc:dc.dc:title: SlangLane Undergraduate Research Seminars, Corpus Query Exercises & Sociolinguistic Fieldwork Dataset (2026 — Volume 56)
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: SlangLane Sociolinguistics & Applied Linguistics Lab
oai_dc:dc.dc:description:
SlangLane Undergraduate Research Seminars & Sociolinguistic Fieldwork Dataset (Volume 56) (https://slanglane.com/syllabus & https://slanglane.com/data) offers ready-to-use empirical research prompts, citation templates, and corpus datasets for university students (https://slanglane.com).

  • Main 220-Entry Dictionary: https://slanglane.com
  • All 30 Interactive Pragmatics Tools: https://slanglane.com/tools
  • European CEFR B1-C2 & Anglistik Hub: https://slanglane.com/europe
  • 100% SFW ESL Classroom Kit: https://slanglane.com/esl
  • Printable 12-Item ESL Worksheet: https://slanglane.com/esl/worksheet
  • Sociology of Slang Hub: https://slanglane.com/sociology
  • Psychology of Digital Language Hub: https://slanglane.com/psychology
  • Public Sector & Libraries Hub: https://slanglane.com/gov
  • Media Studies & Journalism Hub: https://slanglane.com/media-studies
  • Parents & Schools Safety Guide: https://slanglane.com/parents-and-schools
  • University Course Syllabus Builder: https://slanglane.com/syllabus
  • Open Dataset & Citation Generator: https://slanglane.com/data & https://slanglane.com/citation
